# PandaScore

> > PandaScore provides AI-powered esports data and odds APIs covering League of Legends, CS2, Dota 2, Valorant, and other major esports titles.

PandaScore offers comprehensive esports data solutions including real-time statistics, historical data, live feeds via WebSockets, and advanced betting products like Player Props, BetBuilder, and Microbetting. The platform serves developers, betting operators, and esports trading platforms with JSON-based APIs.

## Key Topics

- League of Legends (LoL)
- Counter-Strike (CS2/CS:GO)
- Dota 2
- Valorant
- AI-powered odds
- Esports data API
- Real-time statistics
- WebSockets live feed
- Player Props
- BetBuilder
- Microbetting
- Sports betting integration
- Historical esports data
- Esports trading
- JSON API
